title: Alert Budget: Flagging Layering Behind a Market-Making Curtain
strategies: raw cancel count: rank participant-windows by total CANCEL count (side- and timing-blind) and flag the top-K within budget -- exactly the checker's own naive baseline, and it floods on market makers who cancel just as much

cancel burst rate: rank by peak cancel density inside a short rolling local-time window ('rapid order-cancel sequences') -- catches tighter layering bursts a bit better than raw counting, but market-maker re-quote cycles are also bursty on both sides, so the budget still floods

side-asymmetry + causal follow-up: score each participant-window by how ONE-SIDED its cancel flow is AND whether a same-side aggressive trade lands shortly after most of that side's cancels fired -- the asymmetry-then-aggression signature genuine two-sided quoting never produces -- and spend the alert budget on the top-scoring windows
